component.name: VoCoType
VoCoType
component.summary: Offline voice input for IBus and Fcitx 5
适用于 IBus 与 Fcitx 5 的离线语音输入法

description.p: VoCoType provides push-to-talk offline speech input, terminology handling, inverse text normalization, and optional AI polishing for Linux desktops.
VoCoType 提供按键说话、本地语音识别、术语库、数字与文本规范化，以及可选的 AI 润色。
Fixes Fcitx push-to-talk key release handling and ignores shortcut configuration left behind by uninstalled Fcitx addons.
Reorganizes the repository by module ownership, colocates integrations and services with their tests and deployment assets, and adds structural architecture contracts.
Adds recorded and conflict-checked voice shortcuts plus locked source-built Nix packages for Fcitx 5 and IBus.
Completes the native C++ rewrite, restores the full settings experience, migrates legacy Fcitx profiles, and fixes voice editing, Core lifecycle, and 2-pass configuration.
